annotation.title_clean: Commission Decision (EU) 2025/2371 on the notice regarding the functionality and the fulfilment of the functional specifications of certain electronic systems included in the European Database on Medical Devices
annotation.title_en: Commission Decision (EU) 2025/2371 on the notice regarding the functionality and the fulfilment of the functional specifications of certain electronic systems included in the European Database on Medical Devices
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union
named_instruments_referenced: EU In Vitro Diagnostic Medical Devices Regulation (EU) 2017/746
annotation.summary_en: Commission Decision confirming that four Eudamed electronic systems (actors, UDI/devices, notified bodies/certificates, market surveillance) are functional and meet specifications following an independent audit, triggering transition periods for mandatory use under the EU medical device regulations. It has no AI or robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Confirms four Eudamed electronic systems are functional and meet functional specifications
Based on independent audit report of 18 June 2025
Publication starts transition periods for mandatory use under MDR and IVDR
Enters into force on day of publication in the Official Journal
